paragraphs: Chapter 608
156th Episode. Purification of Chaos (12)
[Get lost!]
Chaos shouted.
The previous oppressive aura was gone. It barely had the size of a wolf now, and it seemed to be shrinking as every second passed.
As Jin was choosing his words, more barbs flew in. The brief respite allowed him to deflect them again, but it was too much to keep facing them in his exhausted state.
'Come to think of it, Chaos always had the opportunity to kill me in the last fights.'
There were too many strange points to consider it just good luck.
However, Jin couldn't be certain that Chaos 'wouldn't kill' him.
Only now, with the clear evidence of the barb stopping at a critical moment, was this fact apparent. But there had been too many moments where he was on the brink of death.
'It's best to get out for now.'
Who knows when Chaos might change its mind.
Jin used the last of his spirit energy to open a fissure towards Lafrarosa. Just before he stepped out, he looked back to see Chaos howling in its unstable state.
"Oh, you came out really quickly this time?"
"Jin, did you finally defeat it!?"
"I can't say I've won yet. But I did weaken it by using the ultimate technique of the spirit sword, and I've regained my strength."
"Now that I think about it, I can feel the strong traces of energy from Jin again... Congratulations!"
"And you said it's weakened, so it's over in the next battle! We'll have to prepare a feast soon."
As his brothers cheered, Jin felt a sense of unease.
'I've longed for victory, and now it's right in front of me, but I don't feel good about it.'
As they approached, Jin explained what he had experienced inside.
"…At the end, when the barb stopped, I got the feeling that it can't kill me. I had thought that it might be the case before... Brothers, did you know about this?"
"It's closer to say that it doesn't, rather than it can't."
At Ban's words, the others tilted their heads.
"You mean, it doesn't kill?"
"That's right."
"Please explain in detail."
"When Jin first ventured into its territory, I too received its inner thoughts."
Ban's gaze fell on Jin's heart. Until now, whenever the two of them were within a mile of the gate of Chaos, they were always in a state of divine union.
The divine union is a kind of resonance, and Chaos is the medium that manifests it.
The divine blood in Jin mixed with Chaos, causing a change, and as a result, Jin and Chaos were able to read each other's thoughts in a certain area.
And the resonance wasn't limited to Jin and Chaos. Like Jin, Ban also had a connection with Chaos, because of its characteristics.
"My resonance with Chaos only occurs when you create a rift to escape from Chaos's domain. Just as you can only read Chaos's thoughts from here."
So, Ban had been reading its emotions every time Jin and Chaos's fight ended. The information Ban found out was as follows:
First, once Chaos took the form of a 'gate', it could never escape that area on its own.
Secondly, it had to wait for Jin to come.
When Ban explained this, Jin seemed to understand why Ban had been so fervently encouraging the fight.
She was sure that Chaos wouldn't kill Jin.
The reason was nothing else.
"Because it's lonely. It had to go into its own domain, but it feels extreme loneliness there. Moreover, the only one who can visit there is you, Jin. If it kills you, it will be alone forever."
-[Tsk, good at running away...! Next time, I'll send you to the other side!]
-[Did it take a bit longer this time?]
-[What, did you bring a toy for the boring day?]
Suddenly, Jin recalled a few things Chaos had said.
Most were jeers and mockery, but sometimes Chaos subtly expressed its loneliness.
'So that's what it meant.'
Jin seemed to understand why he felt uneasy after the fight.
He felt compassion for Chaos.
Of course, it was a strange feeling. Just a little while ago, Jin's feelings for Chaos were close to hatred for a sworn enemy.

But even after Chaos took such a big hit, knowing it couldn't win next time, it stopped the barb at the last minute... In fact, thinking that it was waiting for someone to come and kill him in that dark space.
He couldn't help but feel compassion.
"And in my opinion, I think you, Jin, knew to some extent that it wouldn't kill you. You just didn't think about it in detail because of your anger towards it."
Ban was right.
"…It wasn't just because of anger. It is Chaos. Moreover, it stole all my energy. So for me, it had to be a target that I must suppress, regardless of its psychology."

It wasn't an opponent worth fighting with even a slight shake of heart due to compassion and other emotions. Because it was so strong that it couldn't be defeated even in a well-forged state like a famous sword.
Ban slowly nodded.
"Yes, you're right. That's why I didn't stop you from fighting it until you could win. I thought it would be a great help for your training, and it indeed was."
One of the best driving forces for human growth is hatred.
For the past year and three months, Jin has been dedicated to training and fighting with a deeper anger than ever before. The result was the ultimate technique of the Spirit Sword, First Night.
Moreover, as of today, he has regained all his old power, and the aura and magic he accumulated remain intact.
In terms of pure power, Jin has reached ten stars in both aura and magic. The spirit energy was looking at the late nine stars as it completed the ultimate technique.
Wooooong...!
Suddenly, Jin and Ban's heart of light emitted an even stronger radiance. It was not a phenomenon that both Jin and Ban wanted as always.
A huge force was suddenly rushing into Jin's heart of light. If he hadn't regained his original energy just now, he would have passed out in a few seconds.
He could endure it now. Although he was tired, the energies that had filled his body again were absorbing Ban's power in an instant, like trees receiving rain after a drought.
The problem was Ban.
Because the escaping energy was so much larger than before, Ban showed a momentary sway.
"God Warrior Brothers!"
"God Warrior Brothers are...!"
The Demon King tribe approached Ban in confusion. She raised her hand as if she was fine, but her face showed signs of fatigue.
"Don't fuss, brothers. Let's move outside the training ground."
The God Warrior Fusion was released as soon as they moved a mile away from the training ground.
"Come to think of it, now that Jin has regained all his power, can't we break the gate?"
"That would eliminate the God Warrior Fusion phenomenon... but since Jin's original goal wasn't that, there's no need for him to step in to suppress Chaos now."
Boras answered Nata's words.
"Jin."
"Yes, God Warrior Brothers."
"What will you do?"
"Are you asking if I'm going to kill Chaos?"
"Yes."
The eyes of the Demon King Tribe were focused on Jin.
Ban was expressionless, and the rest of the Demon King tribe were divided in opinion.
There were those who wanted to get rid of the original Chaos immediately and those who felt pity and wanted to watch over it for a while.
"Hmm. Jin, this is your choice, but I think we should spare it."

"Boras, what are you talking about? That thing is the original Chaos. Now that Jin has regained his power, we need to get rid of it immediately. We don't know what hidden power it might have and what problems it might cause in the future if we leave it alone."
"Yes, there's a valid point. You know best how dangerous the original Chaos is, don't you?"
"I can't agree that it's pitiful. If the God Warrior Brothers hadn't taken it from Jin, it would have killed Jin!"

"I know, I understand. But the thing is, Chaos is valuable as a research subject. The enemies that Jin faced outside also used the power of Chaos, and we can research the God Warrior Fusion only if that Chaos exists."
"Brothers."
The Demon King tribe stopped arguing when Jin spoke.
"Firstly, my problem hasn't been fully solved yet. I've regained my power, but...."
Jin rolled up his sleeve to reveal.
"Here, there are still black spots left. It has faded since its power weakened."
"Then if we eliminate it, it will disappear completely. Just say the word, we can't directly enter the realm of Chaos, but eliminating the gate is a piece of cake."
"It, for whatever reason, gave me several chances."
The pupils of the Demon King tribe widened.
"Whether it was lonely, or playing with me was its only pleasure. Anyway, it had several chances to kill me, but it spared me. So, I think I will give it a chance this time."
"No, Jin! Since when did you become so merciful?"

"It's not just for that reason. As Boras said, it has research value. Even without the God Warrior Fusion, I might discover elements from it that could be helpful when I confront Chaos in the future."
The brothers who had been vehemently opposing just a moment ago nodded reluctantly when Jin made his conclusion.
"Of course, if it shows the slightest uncooperative behavior, I will eliminate it immediately."
"If that's Jin's choice, we have no choice but to follow."
"Well, it's not an unreasonable argument."
"I will devote two days to recovery, and I will enter the gate again in the best physical condition. One way or another, the conclusion will be reached then, so please wait a bit."
For the next two days, Jin was able to take a proper rest for the first time in a long time.
And Ban gave the other brothers who had been dedicated to hellish training a chance to rest, often finding the training ground empty.
As if wanting to hear the story of Chaos, he was seen sitting quietly in front of the gate leading to its realm.
"Do you hear the inner voice of Chaos? God Warrior Brothers."
Ban shook his head and replied.
"No, I can't hear without the fissure you created."
She looked very bitter. She must have expected Jin to kill Chaos.
